description: A supplied intuitionistic raw proof of \((\exists xB)^{\mathsf N}\) from \(\Gamma^{\mathsf N}\), and a supplied raw proof of the translated left-renamed \(C\) from the translated context \(\Gamma^\uparrow,\operatorname{open}B\), give an actual raw proof of \(C^{\mathsf N}\) from \(\Gamma^{\mathsf N}\). The protected witness is discharged and the logical-equality mode is retained.
